text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That was... that was a great race!
This is what it's all about, right, Trainy?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was another great run, Hishi Amazon!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she'd race against Narita Brian.
I really think it'd be a great match.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the stands, many people were filled with great anticipation
for the legendary showdown to come.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Here is Hishi Amazon-san, who has drawn widespread attention along the Tiara route for her powerful running.
—The Shuka Sho was a fantastic race!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Heheh, thanks! Going all out in a one-on-one showdown like that was totally satisfying!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I really felt like I'd finally made it this far!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: What do you mean by that?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"...There's nothing I love more than taking on strong opponents.
And there's someone in the Twinkle Series
I absolutely have to face one-on-one."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the mention of the monstrous Umamusume taking the world by storm,
the press conference hall buzzes with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "...But before the Classic year, I just wasn't cut out to challenge her."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided to tear through the Tiara path
and be reborn as an even stronger version of myself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
And now! By charging down the Tiara route,
I've become the "Hishi Amazon" I can truly be proud of!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
So from here on out—
I'm throwing down the gauntlet to Narita Brian!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: Which means the next race is—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, the Arima Kinen... where they'll be waiting!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
So Narita Brian and Hishi Amazon are finally
going to clash on the grandest stage...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! If you don't mind,
could you say a few words to Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon directed
a combative glare at the camera.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Brian. I've been chasing after you this whole time.
The Arima Kinen is the showdown I've been waiting for.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—I'm Hishi Amazon!
I'm coming at you with everything I've got, so just you wait!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"And that's that, Tre-dude!
Let's tackle this with everything we've got!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon's grand declaration of war
was widely reported across various media.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
The 'Arima Kinen', huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so began the days of pushing ourselves
to the limit in preparation for the upcoming
one-on-one showdown against Narita Brian.
